question: What state is attained by one freed from all diseases in relation to union with yogis?
premises: One becomes freed from all diseases.
That one is in relation to yogis.
The result described is union together with yogis.
inference: One freed from all diseases attains union together with yogis.
uncertainties: The precise nature of that union is not elaborated in this verse alone.
plain_english: Freed from all diseases, he attains union together with yogis.
